title: Software Dev Engineer I, Amazon University Talent Acquisition
description:
**Description**
At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. The focus we have on our customers is why we are one of the world’s most beloved brands – customer obsession is part of our company DNA. Our Software Development Engineers (SDEs) use cutting-edge technology to solve complex problems and get to see the impact of their work first-hand. The challenges SDEs solve for at Amazon are big and influence millions of customers, sellers, and products around the world. We are looking for individuals who are passionate about creating new products, features, and services from scratch while managing ambiguity and the pace of a company where development cycles are measured in weeks, not years. If this sounds interesting to you, apply and come chart your own path at Amazon.
  
  
Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. For an update on your status, or to confirm your application was submitted successfully, please login to your candidate portal. NOTE: Amazon works with a high volume of applicants, so we appreciate your patience as we review applications
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Collaborate with experienced cross-disciplinary Amazonians to conceive, design, and bring innovative products and services to market.
* Design and build innovative technologies in a large distributed computing environment and help lead fundamental changes in the industry.
* Create solutions to run predictions on distributed systems with exposure to innovative technologies at incredible scale and speed.
* Build distributed storage, index, and query systems that are scalable, fault-tolerant, low cost, and easy to manage/use.
* Design and code the right solutions starting with broadly defined problems.
* Work in an agile environment to deliver high-quality software.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, computer engineering, or related field
* Knowledge of Computer Science fundamentals such as object-oriented design, algorithm design, data structures, problem solving, and complexity analysis.
* Knowledge of programming languages such as C/C++, Python, Java or Perl

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Previous technical internship(s).
* Experience with distributed, multi-tiered systems, algorithms, and relational databases.
* Experience in optimization mathematics such as linear programming and nonlinear optimization.
* Effectively articulate technical challenges and solutions.
* Adept at handling ambiguous or undefined problems as well as ability to think abstractly.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
  
  
  
**Company**
- ADCI - Karnataka

title: Software Engineer
description:
**Description**
**Leidos**
is seeking an experienced
**Software Engineer**
to join the
**Air Traffic Business**
to support the design, development, integration and delivery of modern software solutions at the integration center in
**Pune, India.**
This role is ideal for a well-rounded software developer who brings strong traditional software engineering fundamentals along with experience or interest in developing and integrating AI-enabled capabilities.
  
  
The Software Engineer will work as part of an Agile development team to build scalable, secure, and reliable applications while leveraging modern development practices, cloud technologies, automation, and emerging artificial intelligence tools and frameworks.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Responsible for software development activities both individually and as a member of a team, including writing, testing, debugging, and maintaining source code within an Agile environment.
* Collaborate with software engineers, systems engineers, data scientists, product owners, and other technical stakeholders to translate requirements into working software.
* Work within Agile/Scrum development environments and participate in code reviews, sprint planning, and technical design discussions.
* Participate throughout the full software development lifecycle (SDLC), including requirements analysis, design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
* Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain high-quality software applications and services.
* Develop software using modern programming languages such as Python, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, C++, C#, or similar technologies.
* Develop automated unit, integration, and system tests to ensure software quality and reliability.
* Utilize modern DevOps and CI/CD practices to automate software builds, testing, deployment, and monitoring.
* Troubleshoot complex software issues and continuously improve application performance, scalability, maintainability, and security.
* Evaluate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, reliability, security, and performance

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline with relevant professional software development experience. Additional experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
* 2+ years of relevant experience or a Master’s Degree
* Fluent in English (both verbal and written) to effectively collaborate with team members and present reports and status.
* Professional experience developing software using one or more modern programming languages such as Python, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, C++, or C#.
* Experience with object-oriented programming, software design principles, algorithms, data structures, and source control tools such as Git.
* Experience developing or integrating APIs, web services, microservices, or distributed applications.
* Experience with modern software development methodologies and the SDLC.
* Experience with Linux environments (Red Hat), virtual machines, and hypervisors
* Familiarity with automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices.
* Experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases.
* Understanding of cloud-based application development using AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Exposure to or experience with AI/ML, Generative AI, LLMs, or AI-enabled application development.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working in the aviation industry or a similar high-tech field is a plus.
* Experience working in a global or multicultural environment is a plus
* Experience developing cloud-native applications and working with cloud-based AI services.
* Experience developing software in highly secure, regulated, mission-critical, or enterprise environments.

If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.

**Pay Range**
Pay Range -
  
  
The Leidos pay range for this job level is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law.
  
  
**About Leidos**
Leidos is an industry and technology leader serving government and commercial customers with smarter, more efficient digital and mission innovations. Headquartered in Reston, Virginia, with 47,000 global employees, Leidos reported annual revenues of approximately $16.7 billion for the fiscal year ended January 3, 2025. For more information, visit www.Leidos.com.
  
  
**Pay And Benefits**
Pay and benefits are fundamental to any career decision. That's why we craft compensation packages that reflect the importance of the work we do for our customers. Employment benefits include competitive compensation, Health and Wellness programs, Income Protection, Paid Leave and Retirement. More details are available at www.leidos.com/careers/pay-benefits.
  
  
**Securing Your Data**
Beware of fake employment opportunities using Leidos’ name. Leidos will never ask you to provide payment-related information during any part of the employment application process (i.e., ask you for money), nor will Leidos ever advance money as part of the hiring process (i.e., send you a check or money order before doing any work). Further, Leidos will only communicate with you through emails that are generated by the Leidos.com automated system – never from free commercial services (e.g., Gmail, Yahoo, Hotmail) or via WhatsApp, Telegram, etc. If you received an email purporting to be from Leidos that asks for payment-related information or any other personal information (e.g., about you or your previous employer), and you are concerned about its legitimacy, please make us aware immediately by emailing us at LeidosCareersFraud@leidos.com.
  
  
If you believe you are the victim of a scam, contact your local law enforcement and report the incident to the U.S. Federal Trade Commission.
  
  
**Commitment to Non-Discrimination**
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, ethnicity, age, national origin, citizenship, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, pregnancy, family structure, marital status, ancestry, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law. Leidos will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with relevant laws.

* Our 4.1-star rating on GlassDoor.

* Familiarity with ML lifecycle tools like MLflow, or data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, Spark, or BigQuery is a plus.

* Ability to work through new and difficult issues and contribute to libraries as needed.
* Ability to create and maintain continuous integration and delivery of applications.
* Forensic attention to detail.
* A positive mindset and a can-do attitude.
* Experience working on Agile/Scrum teams.
* Meaningful experience working on large, complex systems.
* Ability to take extreme ownership over your work. Every day is a challenge to ensure you are performing to the expectations you and your team have agreed upon.
* Ability to identify with the goals of FullStack's clients, and dedicate yourself to delivering on the commitments you and your team make to them.

* The ability to work with leading startups and Fortune 500 companies.

title: Product Developer, Salesforce
description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Product Developer, Salesforce based in India.**
We are seeking a skilled Salesforce developer to build, enhance, and maintain innovative products, reusable assets, and tools that support enterprise technology solutions. In this role, you will combine hands-on Salesforce development with modern AI-assisted engineering practices to deliver scalable, high-quality applications. You will work extensively with Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce Flow, and emerging Agentforce capabilities. Collaborating with product owners, architects, and engineering teams, you will turn business requirements into practical solutions throughout the software development lifecycle. This remote opportunity is ideal for a developer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, experimenting with cutting-edge AI tools, and contributing to product innovation in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Salesforce Product Development: Develop, enhance, and support new and existing Salesforce products, reusable assets, and strategic tools that improve the delivery of Salesforce solutions.
* Custom Application Development: Build and maintain Salesforce functionality using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce Flow, Console, and other relevant platform capabilities.
* AI-Assisted Engineering: Use AI development tools, including Claude and Codex, to improve coding efficiency, accelerate development tasks, and support effective engineering practices.
* Solution Design and Prototyping: Participate in technical design, proofs of concept, and solution validation, ensuring proposed approaches meet business requirements and align with Salesforce best practices.
* Testing and Quality Assurance: Execute unit testing for assigned development tasks, identify and resolve defects, and ensure the reliability, maintainability, and performance of delivered solutions.
* Full Software Development Lifecycle: Contribute to all stages of product development, from ideation and planning through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing product improvement.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with product owners, product engineering leads, technical architects, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver scalable, value-driven solutions.
* Code Reviews and Technical Documentation: Participate in code reviews, peer inspections, and technical design discussions. Maintain clear specifications and documentation to support consistent development standards.
* Integration Development: Build and maintain integrations between Salesforce and external systems, ensuring reliable data exchange and effective interoperability.
* Product Planning and Prioritization: Collaborate with the wider product team to assess market needs, refine and prioritize work, and align on solution designs that support business objectives.
* Continuous Learning and Platform Improvement: Stay current with Salesforce releases, new platform capabilities, AI-driven development practices, and emerging technologies to continuously improve product quality and delivery.

**Requirements**

* Professional Experience: At least four years of hands-on Salesforce development experience, with a strong understanding of Salesforce architecture, platform capabilities, and technical constraints.
* Salesforce Development: Strong proficiency in Apex and Lightning Web Components (LWC), with the ability to develop maintainable, scalable, and high-quality custom solutions.
* Programming Fundamentals: Solid understanding of object-oriented programming principles, software design patterns, and good development practices.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or an equivalent qualification or background.
* Salesforce Architecture: Ability to evaluate Salesforce platform capabilities and design solutions that balance functionality, scalability, performance, and maintainability.
* System Integrations: Experience developing and maintaining integrations between Salesforce and external applications or services.
* Development Lifecycle and DevOps: Practical experience with Salesforce DX, source control, CI/CD processes, and modern software development workflows.
* AI Development Tools: Willingness and ability to use AI-assisted development tools effectively to improve productivity and support technical problem-solving.
* Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, including the capacity to translate business needs into clear technical requirements and implementation approaches.
* Communication and Collaboration: Excellent communication skills and the ability to work constructively with product, engineering, and architecture teams in a collaborative environment.
* Preferred Front-End Skills: Familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and responsive web design.
* Preferred Agentforce Experience: Experience with Salesforce Agentforce solutions or other AI-powered Salesforce capabilities is an advantage.
* Additional Salesforce Expertise: Familiarity with Service Cloud and Service Cloud Voice is beneficial.
* Related Technology Experience: Experience developing digital-channel or contact-center applications is a plus, as is exposure to AWS development.
* Packaging Knowledge: Familiarity with Salesforce packaging processes is beneficial.

description:

* Implement and activate new alerts as needed, or modify existing ones to ensure optimal system performance.

* Track system performance and catch issues proactively using application logs and monitoring dashboards. Diagnose and resolve configuration errors, database connection drops, environment bottlenecks, and deployment failures.

* Work non-standard hours as necessary to support your teams and stakeholders in ongoing incident mitigation, which may occur at any time or day of the week.
* Create and maintain support documentation, and help evolve standard practices and procedures.
* Identify and collaborate on automation opportunities to improve support efficiency.
* Conduct detailed knowledge transfer sessions for production support teams for key projects including assessment for additional monitoring and alerting, or changes.

* 4+ years of software engineering in development, application support, DevOps/SRE, including incident, change and problem management using an enterprise ITSM tool.
* Proficiency in Java, Scala, or other object-oriented programming languages for conducting comprehensive technical analysis and independent debugging.
* Hands-on experience with Splunk or other monitoring/observability tools, and working experience with RDBMS and PL/SQL and cloud infrastructure such as AWS.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills in high-pressure outages, with the ability to conduct root cause analysis and articulate technical problems clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Working experience on cloud infra, like AWS, is a plus
* Good knowledge of Unix Shell Scripting
* Support experience with eCommerce platform is a plus
* Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science or a related STEM field.

At Fujitsu, our purpose is to make the world more sustainable by building trust in society through innovation. Founded in Japan in 1935, Fujitsu has been a pioneer in technology and innovation for decades. Today, as a world-leading digital transformation partner, we are committed to transforming business and society in the digital age.
  
  
With approximately 130,000 employees across over 50 countries, Fujitsu offers a broad range of products, services, and solutions. We collaborate with our customers to co-create solutions that drive enterprise-wide digitalization while actively working to address social issues and contribute to the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
  
  
**Job Summary**
Lead the end-to-end solutioning of ServiceNow opportunities—from client discovery and solution design through estimation, proposal, bid defence, and transition to delivery. The role converts business and service-management needs into a practical platform roadmap, implementation approach, managed-services model, and measurable value case.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead qualification, discovery workshops, solution design, estimation, proposal development, demonstrations, bid defence, and delivery handover.
* Assess client processes, platform maturity, pain points, governance, data readiness, user experience, and transformation priorities.
* Design fit-for-purpose solutions across ITSM, ITOM, SPM, CSM, HRSD, SecOps, GRC, Asset Management, and Enterprise Service Management.
* Translate requirements into process designs, user journeys, platform capabilities, integrations, scope, roadmap, and operating model.
* Define assumptions, dependencies, risks, responsibilities, effort, team structure, commercials, and delivery approach.
* Create RFP responses, statements of work, solution narratives, estimates, benefit cases, and executive presentations.
* Work with technical, delivery, commercial, partner, and client teams to ensure the solution is scalable, secure, commercially sound, and delivery-ready.
* Develop reusable propositions, estimation models, workshop assets, and industry-specific ServiceNow solutions.

Presales & Solution Expertise
  
  

* Strong IT service management process design experience and practical knowledge of ITIL-aligned operating models.
* Deep functional knowledge of ITSM, ITOM, and Strategic Portfolio Management / ITBM, with broader awareness of adjacent ServiceNow workflows.
* Strong experience with ServiceNow implementation, development, upgrades, maintenance, platform administration, and technical architecture.
* Hands-on knowledge of ServiceNow scripting and configuration, including JavaScript, Glide APIs, client and server-side components, security rules, flows, notifications, import sets, and custom applications.
* Deep integration knowledge covering REST, SOAP/WSDL, JSON, MID Server, Integration Hub, authentication patterns, error handling, monitoring, and integration support.
* Experience defining service catalogs, request models, CMDB governance, service mapping outcomes, asset processes, metrics, SLAs, dashboards, reporting, and Performance Analytics requirements.
* Understanding platform implementation lifecycle, upgrades, release governance, testing, training, organizational change, adoption, and managed-service operations.
* Proven experience estimating functional scope and identifying cost drivers, risks, dependencies, exclusions, and conditions required for a credible commercial model.

**Qualifications / Certifications**

* Bachelor's degree in business, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* 10+ years of IT experience with significant ServiceNow consulting, process transformation, solutioning, or presales responsibility.
* 5+ years of IT service management process design experience and strong exposure to ServiceNow implementations or transformations.
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator preferred; one or more relevant Certified Implementation Specialist credentials strongly preferred.
* ITIL certification is strongly preferred; process, architecture, agile, project, change-management, or business-analysis certification is advantageous.
* Experience in at least 2-3 end-to-end ServiceNow implementation or major transformation and multiple complex presales pursuits is preferred.

**Soft Skills & Success Measures**

* Excellent written, oral, presentation, facilitation, and executive stakeholder-management skills.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, estimation, decision-making, and structured problem-solving capability.
* Quality-oriented mindset with disciplined production of proposals, architectures, estimates, assumptions, and delivery-ready artifacts.
* Collaborative team players who can mobilize matrix teams, manage competing priorities, and work effectively across cultures and time zones.

**Experience**
10+ years in IT, including strong ServiceNow consulting, process design, solutioning, and presales experience
  
  
Primary focus
  
  
Platform architecture, integration, security, data, automation, technical estimation, and end-to-end presales, service design, and value realization
  
  
Key domains
  
  
ITSM, ITOM, SPM/ITBM, CSM, HRSD, SecOps, GRC, Asset Management, and Enterprise Service Management as relevant
  
  
**Location:**
Flexible, with travel as required
  
  
Relocation Supported: Yes
  
  
Visa Sponsorship Approved: No
